multi_copy_atomicity.english: Once a write is observed by one observer, all observers must see it (no write coalescing or store-buffer divergence)

id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

typical_topologies_apb: Single APB bridge (Manager) + multiple APB peripherals.
Single Manager bus only; no multi-Manager arbitration.

interconnect_role_ahb.decoder: Generates one HSELx per Subordinate; 1KB min granularity; drives multiplexor select retimed to data phase.
interconnect_role_ahb.multiplexor: Routes HRDATA/HRESP/HREADYOUT/HEXOKAY back to Manager; combines all HREADYOUTs into HREADY.
interconnect_role_ahb.default_slave: ERROR for NONSEQ/SEQ to unmapped addresses, zero-wait OKAY for IDLE/BUSY.
interconnect_role_ahb.multi_manager: Multi-Manager requires interconnect with arbitration (outside AHB spec scope).

interconnect_role_apb.bridge: APB Manager — decodes upstream accesses into APB transfers; maps PSLVERR back to upstream protocol's error.
interconnect_role_apb.psel_routing: Bridge decodes upper PADDR bits for per-peripheral PSELx.

interconnect_rules_ahb: Decoder drives HSELx during address phase.
HSELx may be asserted or deasserted for IDLE.
Multiplexor control retimed to data phase.
Single centralized decoder + multiplexor required for >=2 Subordinates.
Default Subordinate returns ERROR for unmapped NONSEQ/SEQ.
Multiple HSELx may be asserted for a single Subordinate (multiple logical interfaces).
HREADY computed by combining all Subordinate HREADYOUTs.
Generic interconnect may offer AHB alongside AXI/APB.
interconnect_rules_apb: Bridge generates one PSELx per peripheral.
Only one PSELx asserted per transfer.
Bridge holds outputs stable while PREADY=0.
Peripherals without PSLVERR: input tied LOW at bridge.

id_routing_ahb.description: AHB-Lite has no ID. AHB5 HMASTER is modified by the interconnect to be globally unique.
id_routing_ahb.implication: HMASTER_WIDTH must accommodate all Manager IDs in the system.

guaranteed: Beats of a burst presented in HBURST-defined order.
Single-Manager AHB-Lite: strict request order = response order.
Strict in-order on a single APB bus.
not_guaranteed: Ordering across multiple independent APB busses.

memory_vs_peripheral_regions.ahb_memory_subordinate: Maps to a memory region; handles all bursts/sizes correctly.
memory_vs_peripheral_regions.ahb_peripheral_subordinate: Typically connected via an AHB-to-APB bridge; APB peripheral behaviour governed by APB protocol.
memory_vs_peripheral_regions.apb_peripheral_region: PADDR-mapped peripheral register set; one PSELx per logical peripheral.

slave_classification_ahb.Peripheral_Subordinate: Often APB peripheral behind AHB-to-APB bridge.
slave_classification_ahb.Default_Subordinate: ERROR for NONSEQ/SEQ at unmapped, zero-wait OKAY for IDLE/BUSY.

slave_classification_apb.Memory_mapped_peripheral: Standard APB peripheral; uses PREADY to extend ACCESS phase if needed.
slave_classification_apb.Fixed_two_cycle_peripheral: PREADY tied HIGH; every transfer completes in exactly 2 PCLK cycles.
slave_classification_apb.PSLVERR_supporting: Drives PSLVERR=1 in the cycle PREADY=1 to indicate failure.
slave_classification_apb.Non_PSLVERR_supporting: PSLVERR input to the bridge tied LOW.
